archetypes.name: dyn-invariant-flow
archetypes.rationale: Invariant assessment handling now spans Gate C, publish refusal, summaries, and run-log completeness.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the invariant assessment flow across Gate C prose, Step 5c publish refusal, direct log publish warnings, final summary prefixes, and run-log required artifacts. Check that invariant-missing behavior is ordered before guideline-missing behavior without weakening existing guideline semantics. Pay special attention to empty parsed invariant files and approved-partition outcomes. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
